evidence.title: Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Judges: A Label-Free Double-Centering Calibrator

summary: Researchers introduce a label-free double-centering calibrator to correct inconsistencies in rankings produced by multilingual large language model judges. The approach aims to improve fairness and accuracy in cross-lingual AI assessments.
title: New Calibration Method Addresses Rank Reversal in Multilingual LLM Evaluations
